Native leakage-aware Gaussian and binomial FPCR cross-validation

etr_cross_validate_fpca_regression.Rd

Refits FPCA and Gaussian OLS or binomial logit regression inside each training fold and projects held-out trajectories using only the training basis. Whole-group held-out folds prevent participant leakage, while isolated seeded curve folds allow reproducible sensitivity studies. The grouped sort profile selects the implementation of mixed-size ties. Binomial inference uses R stats::glm.fit; its IRLS and separation warnings can differ from statsmodels. Pandas nonnumeric-to-float source-fitting coercions remain outside the default; optional finite text conversion is a native-only extension; this is not independent full-domain source certification.

Usage

etr_cross_validate_fpca_regression(trajectories, outcome,
  candidate_components = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L),
  family = "gaussian", loss = NULL, covariates = NULL,
  n_splits = 5L, scaling = "none", cv_unit = "curve",
  group_column = NULL, shuffle = FALSE, random_state = 0L,
  fold_assignments = NULL,
  coerce_numeric_text_covariates = FALSE, random_engine = "base_R",
  group_tie_order = "native", strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

strict_source_record

If TRUE, return the six canonical frozen Python 1.2 scientific provenance fields and require source-compatible fold generation; shuffled curve folds must use random_engine="numpy", grouped folds an explicit NumPy tie-order profile, and R-only supplied fold assignments and numeric-text covariate coercion are rejected. The default FALSE preserves native diagnostic provenance. Runtime classes and full exceptional domains are not independently certified.

coerce_numeric_text_covariates

Native-only opt-in for finite numeric-text covariate columns (including interdigit underscores). The frozen Python validator parses text but source statsmodels rejects object-typed columns, so FALSE preserves the default source-safe behavior.

trajectories

Complete native common-grid trajectory set.

outcome

Curve-aligned finite numeric, logical, or decimal numeric-looking character outcomes. Logical TRUE/FALSE becomes numeric 1/0; binomial responses must be 0/1. R factors are not converted to their integer codes.

candidate_components

Positive integer retained FPC counts.

family

"gaussian" or "binomial" for Bernoulli logistic regression.

loss

Gaussian: "rmse" (default) or "mae". Binomial: "log_loss" (default) or "brier".

covariates

NULL or a curve-aligned data.frame of finite numeric or logical covariate columns. Names must be unique and must not collide with const or reserved FPC score names. Columns are included in the Gaussian OLS or binomial logit model fitted inside each training fold and in matching held-out predictions.

n_splits

KFold or GroupKFold partition count, from two up to the number of curves or unique groups respectively.

scaling

One of "none" or "dimension_sd".

cv_unit

"curve" or "group"; group CV excludes every curve from a held-out participant/group from training folds.

group_column

Metadata column containing group identifiers; required for cv_unit="group".

shuffle

Logical flag for shuffled curve folds. Group CV is deterministic.

random_state

Nonnegative integer seed for shuffled curve folds, ignored for unshuffled or grouped folds. The NumPy engine accepts seeds up to \(2^{32}-1\).

group_tie_order

Grouped sort profile. See etr_cross_validate_fpca_reconstruction for the native, NumPy SIMD and NumPy scalar options and supported domains. Explicit fold assignments take precedence.

random_engine

"base_R" retains the original native shuffle. "numpy" reproduces scikit-learn's seeded NumPy RandomState permutation.

fold_assignments

Optional complete zero-based integer fold IDs matching a source KFold/GroupKFold result. Grouped units must never straddle folds. This overrides native fold generation without altering fitting or predictions.

Value

Retained fold-loss, assignment and out-of-fold prediction frames and source-shaped scientific provenance. Group assignments have an additional `group` label column when grouping is requested.
